channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: U.S. bases in Gulf become Achilles heel as Iran inflicts 'unprecedented damage', says report
item.description: Iran's strikes damaged at least 16 U. S. installations across eight countries in the Gulf region. The attacks inflicted significant damage, according to a report. U. S. bases in the region have become vulnerable.

item.title: U.S. to close its flagship Gaza mission as Donald Trump plan stalls
item.description: The U. S. will close its flagship Gaza mission, the Civil-Military Coordination Centre in Israel. This move marks another setback for President Donald Trump's Gaza plan. The closure was announced recently.

item.title: U.S. approves military sales of over $8.6 billion to West Asia allies
item.description: The US approved military sales of over $8.6 billion to West Asia allies. The announcements came after a fragile ceasefire. The announcements came ‌as the U. S. and Israel’s war against Iran marked nine ‌weeks since its start and ‌more ⁠than three weeks since a ⁠fragile ceasefire came into effect.

item.title: ‘You cannot give Iran a nuclear weapon’: Trump says US won’t allow Tehran to rebuild capabilities
item.description: Donald Trump stated that the U. S. won't allow Iran to rebuild its nuclear capabilities. He emphasized that giving Iran a nuclear weapon is not an option. The U. S. will take measures to prevent it.

item.title: Trump says US forces are ‘like pirates’ taking Iranian oil
item.description: Donald Trump compared U. S. forces to pirates, saying they intercept Iranian ships and cargo near the Strait of Hormuz. The U. S. forces take control of the vessels. This has been happening recently.

item.title: Iran Loses $4.8 Billion In Oil Revenue Due To US Blockade: Report
item.description: Iran lost $4.8 billion in oil revenue due to the U. S. blockade. The blockade has significantly impacted Iran's economy. The loss is substantial, according to a report. A US soldier points a heavy-calibre machinegun at a vessel in the waterway near Iran.

item.title: "Ceasefire Gives Additional Time": Trump As 60-Day Iran War Clock Stops
item.description: President Donald Trump told Congress that hostilities in Iran have terminated. President Donald Trump told top US lawmakers on Friday that hostilities in Iran had ended, after coming under pressure from Congress to seek authorization for the conflict as it headed into its third month.

item.title: Spirit Airlines appears closer to shutdown as time dwindles for government bailout
item.description: Spirit Airlines faces shutdown as government bailout time runs out. The airline is in bankruptcy proceedings for the second time in two years, struggling with soaring jet fuel prices due to the Iran war.

item.title: Trump Approves Nearly $9 Billion Weapons Sales To Israel, UAE, Other Mideast Allies Amid Iran War
item.description: US President Trump approved nearly $9 billion in weapons sales to Israel, the UAE, and other Middle East allies. The sales come amid rising tensions with Iran. Representational Image. Trump Approves Nearly $9 Billion Weapons Sales To Israel, UAE, Other Mideast Allies Amid Iran War.

item.title: Germany's Iran "Humiliating" US Comment Costs It 5,000 American Troops
item.description: The US is withdrawing 5,000 troops from Germany over six to twelve months. The Pentagon said the withdrawal was expected to be completed over the next six to twelve months.

item.title: Trump Warns Of More Oil Disruptions, US Aircraft Carrier Leaves Gulf
item.description: US President Trump warned of more oil disruptions. A US aircraft carrier has left the Gulf region. US Israel Iran War Ceasefire News LIVE Updates. Trump Warns Of More Oil Disruptions, US Aircraft Carrier Leaves Gulf.

item.title: Spirit Airlines prepares to shut down operations overnight, sources say
item.description: Spirit Airlines is preparing to shut down operations overnight. The collapse will result in thousands of lost jobs. The collapse of Spirit will result in thousands of lost jobs and marks the first airline to fail in part due to a doubling in jet fuel prices during the two-month-old Iran war.

item.title: Havana slams new Trump sanctions as ‘collective punishment’ of Cuban people
item.description: The Cuban government rejected new US sanctions as "collective punishment" of the Cuban people. The sanctions were levied by US President Donald Trump. The Cuban government has firmly rejected the recent sanctions levied by US President Donald Trump.

item.title: Why 60-day War Powers Resolution Deadline Doesn't Constrain Presidents
item.description: The US Congress passed a 60-day War Powers Resolution deadline, but the Trump administration signaled on April 30 it would ignore the deadline, indicating no intention to comply with the congressional mandate.

item.title: Trump tells Congress ceasefire means he does not need their approval for Iran war
item.description: US President Trump claims congressional approval is no longer needed for a war with Iran, citing a ceasefire as proof hostilities have terminated. He made the statement in a letter to Congress on 10 April 2026.

item.title: Donald Trump says Iran war ‘terminated’ as ceasefire holds, in letter to Congress
item.description: Donald Trump said the Iran war is "terminated" in a letter to Congress. A ceasefire in the conflict is holding. Donald Trump says Iran war ‘terminated’ as ceasefire holds, in letter to Congress.

item.title: Netflix to give Greta Gerwig’s 'Narnia' wide theatrical release, marking a first
item.description: Netflix will give Greta Gerwig's 'Narnia' a wide theatrical release, marking a first for the streaming service. The film will be shown in cinemas worldwide, departing from Netflix's typical direct-to-streaming model.

item.title: US withdrawing 5,000 troops from Germany after Merz says US ‘humiliated’ by Iran
item.description: The US will withdraw 5,000 troops from Germany, a decision made after a German politician stated the US was 'humiliated' by Iran. The move comes amid ongoing tensions in the region.

item.title: US to withdraw about 5,000 troops from Germany
item.description: The US plans to withdraw about 5,000 troops from Germany, a move that follows years of threats from US President Donald Trump to slash US troop numbers in Germany and other European allies.

item.title: US said to be withdrawing 5,000 troops from Germany over Iran war spat
item.description: US President Donald Trump is withdrawing 5,000 troops from Germany amid a row with European allies over Iran. The move follows Trump's feud with European leaders over their reluctance to support war on Iran.
